asset_manifest.pose: An adult female grad student of Caucasian ethnicity with long blonde hair tied back, wearing a white sun hat, a light pink collared shirt under a khaki safari vest, khaki shorts, and pink hiking boots, kneels on the damp shoreline. She laughs and points joyfully at a series of clear, webbed marine reptile trackway prints in the wet sand. A tiny, cute juvenile sauropterygian is curled up taking a nap inside the largest footprint impression, while a stylized, friendly adult Nothosaurus with an expressive, toothy grin stands nearby looking at them with satisfaction.

visual_notes.text_style: Bright Coral-Orange, high-poly 3D mixed case text with a glossy finish to match the STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3 aesthetic, positioned prominently in the upper third.
visual_notes.ground_texture: Glistening, fine-grained wet tidal sand and dark grey mud with water-ripple textures and shallow puddles reflecting the bright blue sky, characteristic of the coastal MUSCHELKALK formation.
visual_notes.ichnology_spec: The foreground features deep, clear negative trackway impressions showing a five-toed plantigrade pattern with distinct skin-webbing membranes stretched between the splayed toes and soft, raised mud-heave borders.
visual_notes.character_consistency: The paleontologist perfectly displays the blonde hair, white sun hat, pink accent top, and pink utility boots mapped to character library ID dino_bones_paleontologist_4.
